label: alg:categorical-action
title: Categorical action $\rho_n\colon B_n \to \mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbf{C}}(V^{\otimes n})$
html:
Algorithm. Categorical action \rho_n\colon B_n \to \mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbf{C}}(V^{\otimes n})

Algorithm (Categorical action of the braid group). Construct the representation \rho_n\colon B_n \to \mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbf{C}}(V^{\otimes n}) that sends each braid generator \sigma_i to a categorical endomorphism of the n-fold monoidal product V^{\otimes n} in \mathbf{C}.

Input

  • Braid word w = \sigma_{i_1}^{\varepsilon_1} \cdots \sigma_{i_k}^{\varepsilon_k} in B_n.
  • Underlying rigid monoidal category \mathbf{C} with chosen generating object V \in \mathbf{C}.

Output

  • Endomorphism \rho_n(w) \in \mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbf{C}}(V^{\otimes n}) as a finite composition of categorical generators (braiding c_{V,V}, dualities \mathrm{ev}_V, \mathrm{coev}_V, associator, unit).

Algorithm

1. For each generator σ_i in w:
     interpret σ_i as id^{i-1} ⊗ c_{V,V} ⊗ id^{n-i-1}
     where c_{V,V} is the braiding of C at (V, V).
2. For σ_i^{-1}: use c_{V,V}^{-1} = c_{V,V}^* (left-rigid dual).
3. Compose in order along w; the result is ρ_n(w).

Correctness conditions

Correctness rests on three upstream results.

  1. The categorical action is well-defined by def:categorical-action — the braiding c_{V,V} in a rigid monoidal category satisfies the braid (Yang–Baxter) relations on V^{\otimes n} by naturality of the hexagon axioms.
  2. It exists under the QOU rigid-monoidal premise by prop:categorical-action-exists.
  3. It is unique up to natural isomorphism by prop:categorical-action-unique.

Complexity

O(k) categorical morphisms for |w| = k. The endomorphism is stored implicitly as a braid word until passed to the next step (GS reduction), so the representation is lazy — no matrix exponentiation occurs at this layer.

Python / Rust API entry point

No standalone Python entry point — the categorical action is the upstream specification, realised implicitly inside the Rust hecke-engine crate at tools/hecke-engine/src/lib.rs. Per-particle braid words are constructed via pyhecke.build_nucleon_nf / pyhecke.build_atom_nf and consumed by Step 2 (GS reduction).

Witness contract

No standalone witness JSON: correctness is checked structurally (braid relations are obeyed by the Hecke-relation specialisation in Step 2). Property tests live in tools/hecke-engine/tests/.

Notes

The categorical action is fibre-independent. It depends strictly on the rigid-monoidal structure of \mathbf{C}, independent of the fibre functor \tau. Archimedean specialisation enters at Step 9 (the nucleon mass ratio) via Markov trace evaluation at q_0.
